summary: The study demonstrates the ALD deposition of Ruthenium for 10 nm half-pitch interconnects, showing low resistivity and good filling with no electromigration failures. The process uses EBECHRu and O2 as precursors at 325°C, and the resistivity is found to be relatively independent of cross-sectional area, making Ru a promising alternative to Cu for advanced interconnects.
evidence: All Ru films were deposited by ALD using (ethylbenzyl) (1-ethyl-1,4-cyclohexadienyl) Ru (0) (EBECHRu) in combination with O2 as the reactant. The deposition temperature was 325°C. The Ru resistivity was almost independent of the cross-sectional area, indicating very low sensitivity of Ru to dimension-dependent additional scattering mechanisms.
